functions.name: check_runs
functions.description: GitHub check runs are distinct from Actions jobs and workflow attempts. All reruns remain separate identities; runs with missing suites or apps remain visible. The explicit node-ID route adds typed GraphQL-only context; ordinary routes leave that context NULL as unrequested. Numeric IDs and repository membership are verified before REST hydration. Deployment ID and typed deployment metadata are available from ordinary REST responses; the node route adds deployment_context with GraphQL current state/commit context and pending approvals.

functions.name: check_steps
functions.description: Canonical check-run steps at repository/run/step-number grain. All run/suite/reference paths preserve reruns and independently paginate each run connection. These records belong to GraphQL CheckRun; no identity equivalence with an Actions job or its nested REST steps is invented. Step numbers are parent-local indices, with external ID and reported seconds-to-completion retained.
